name: Epsilon
description: A purpose-built Attack prototype engineered to break Boss-class opponents. Shop exclusive.

ability.name: Boss Breaker
ability.description: Against Boss Beys, Epsilon deals +25% damage. Each Attack win in a boss battle builds +8% base ATK, up to 3 stacks (+24%). These bonuses are inactive against normal Beys.

special_move.name: Epsilon Overdrive
special_move.description: A prototype overdrive strike built for Boss-class targets. 175 base damage with +55% ATK bonus damage; against a Boss Bey, final Special damage is increased by 20%.
